component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Metanode for the update/creation of the flow variables holding e.g. experimental design and or comparisons to be made.
Check the box prior the given flow variable setting if you want to get the value updated by the metanode!
Connect the metanode using the input and 1st outputtable connections. Second and third output tables presenting flow variables are mainly for easier validation of the metanode output.
